title: PricklyPvP
description: PricklyPvP is a clean PvP resource pack designed for crystal PvP and competitive combat, featuring improved visibility, optimized textures, and a sleek dark aesthetic.
body:
PricklyPvP is a lightweight PvP resource pack focused on:

• Clean GUI
• Better sword visibility
• Low distraction textures
• Crystal PvP friendly
• Dark themed interface

Recommended for:
Crystal PvP
SMP PvP
FFA
Practice Servers

And Don't Forget To Listen Songs On Disc Of Minecraft, Recommended To Listen Via This Command /playsound minecraft:music_disc.disc-name.

Minecraft Versions:
1.21+

Created by:
Pricklyspider211

If you like the pack, don't forget to leave a Follow! It helps a lot.
